notes: Totals within 0.5 % of Fraport for CFU/EFL/ZTH support reading Fraport 'Flights' as movements (arrivals + departures). Fraport publishes no definition (ASSUMPTION, well supported).
PVK +3.7 %: agy attributes this to military/state IFR movements at Aktion (ASSUMPTION, plausible, not checked).
No row for 2025-02-28 at any of the four airports (cause not checked).

The daily file is not day-complete: e.g. LGKR lacks 19 January 2025 days, including 2025-01-13..01-22, while Fraport reports 130 CFU flights that month. Absent days are not zero traffic (corrected after independent review round 2, 2026-11-06). Use monthly or annual FLT_TOT_1 only, never daily.

notes: agy reported this query as returning no data with rep_airp=LGKR and did not test the EL_ codes; Claude Code tested them: populated.

evidence.provider: Hellenic Slot Coordination Authority (hsca.gr); document footer 'Fraport Greece - September 2024'
evidence.findings: Page 3 table 'Declared S25 Runway & Terminal Coordination Parameters' with columns ARR R60, DEP R60, TTL R60, ARR R20, TTL R20, TTL R15, ARR T60/10, DEP T60/10, L/F. Rows: CFU level 3 '8 12 20 7'; EFL level 3 '3 6 2'; PVK level 2 '4 8'; ZTH level 3 banded '3 7 2' / '4 8 2'. R60/60 applies to ZTH and EFL, R60/20 to CFU, R60/15 to PVK. Page 4 stands: CFU 9 + 2 (MARS), EFL 3 + 1 (MARS).
evidence.unresolved: Text extraction collapses empty cells, so the column of each value is not determinable from text alone. Across airports the second value is about twice the first (RHO 11/22, SKG 13/26, JMK 5/12), which suggests ARR R60 / TTL R60 rather than ARR / DEP. agy's reading (EFL ARR 3, DEP 6, TTL 9; TTL R20 = 2 for EFL/ZTH) is therefore not reproduced. Needs visual reading of page 3 before any figure is cited.
evidence.on_agy_threshold_grounding: RISK: agy states the Data06 thresholds 4/3/3/3 'directly match' HSCA parameters. The thresholds are an instantaneous aircraft count in a 25 km / 3,000 m buffer; HSCA values are hourly or 20-minute movement rates. Matching numbers is post-hoc, not a derivation. The thresholds stay ASSUMPTION; HSCA is the candidate basis for a re-specified threshold.
evidence.citable_after_review: Independent review round 2 (2026-11-06) resolved the p.3 header (ARR R60 | DEP R60 | TTL R60 | ARR R20 | TTL R20 | TTL R15 | ARR T60/10 | DEP T60/10 | L/F). Citable: runway ARR R60 / TTL R60 = CFU 8/20, EFL 3/6, ZTH 3-4/7-8, PVK 4/8; terminal ARR/DEP T60/10 and L/F = CFU 1,250/1,250/90 %, EFL 1,130/630/90 %, ZTH 1,260/970/90 %, PVK 570/630/80 %. Not citable without a visual read: DEP R60 and the R20/R15 columns. The banded rows '5 11 4' / '4 10 3' belong to CHQ (Chania), not CFU; agy's 'CFU ARR R20 = 4' and '20-minute windows 4/2/2/3' are unsupported.
